MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

2. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)

   B. 33
   C. 32
   D. 4

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)

   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. 1/4

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 24

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
